name: Minister 2
overview: The Scriptures present ministers as individuals entrusted with significant authority and responsibility under God's sovereign rule. Joseph's elevation by Pharaoh to oversee all Egypt demonstrates God's provision of wise leadership to govern His people effectively, with authority second only to the king himself. Similarly, Ira the Jairite is noted as a chief ruler serving King David, highlighting the trusted role of ministers in guiding and supporting godly leadership. These examples from the lives of Joseph and Ira illustrate the biblical principle that ministers serve as vital instruments in administering God's purposes within earthly realms.
